name: Meta Tags Preview (SERP)
summary: Preview how a title and meta description may look in Google search results — locally.
description: Enter a page title, meta description, and URL to see a Google-style SERP snippet with character counts, truncation heuristics, and copy-ready HTML for title, description, canonical, and Open Graph tags. Planning aid only — not a live ranking check.

faqs.question: Are the character limits exact?
faqs.answer: No. Google truncates by pixel width and may rewrite snippets. Forge uses common ~60 / ~155 character planning heuristics.

faqs.question: Does this check my live page?
faqs.answer: No. Paste draft copy to preview. It does not crawl URLs.

faqs.question: What HTML is generated?
faqs.answer: title, meta description, canonical link, and basic og:title / og:description / og:url tags.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs in your browser.
